CustomField.description: QCC: Departure Delay in Hrs and MIN
CustomField.formula: IF (TechDepartureDelayDuration__c > 0, TEXT( FLOOR( 24 * TechDepartureDelayDuration__c)) & " Hrs " & TEXT( ROUND(60 * (ROUND( 24 * (TechDepartureDelayDuration__c - FLOOR(TechDepartureDelayDuration__c) ),8) - FLOOR( ROUND( 24 * (TechDepartureDelayDuration__c - FLOOR(TechDepartureDelayDuration__c) ),8)) ),0)) & " Mins " , "No Departure Delay")
CustomField.label: Departure Delay Length
